page_title: STR 0-1 MON | Strasbourg v Monaco 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+1' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) who sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' It is time for a substitution. Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is on for Wissam Ben Yedder.
86' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
86' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) steps up to send the ball in.

86' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
85' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
85' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
82' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sees a yellow card from Clement Turpin after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

81' Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
80' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

80' Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Strasbourg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Ismael Doukoure and he is replaced by Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Delaine departs the field of play to be replaced by Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg).
79' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
77' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Alaa Bellaarouch to dive and make a save.
76' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Monaco.

75' A precise low pass is received by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
74' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Clement Turpin didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
72' 0 - 1 Goal! Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Maghnes Akliouche, then sends ball into the top left corner. 0:1.
68' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Junior Mwanga will be replaced by Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg).
64' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
62' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alaa Bellaarouch intercepts the ball.
59' Substitution. Kassoum Ouattara is replaced by Ismail Jakobs (Monaco).
59' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) replacing Takumi Minamino.
59' A substitution has been made. Youssouf Fofana goes off and Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) comes on.
58' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

55' What a chance! Wilfried Singo (Monaco) rises high to meet the corner and plants a fine header goalwards, but the goalkeeper is alert and pulls off an astonishing reflex save. The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
54' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
54' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Now Monaco have a corner.
53' Monaco are seeing far more of the ball now.
49' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) commits a rough foul. Clement Turpin stops the game and makes a call.
47' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) crosses the ball from the free kick, but his attempt is overhit and it goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
47' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is penalised for holding. Clement Turpin signals a set piece. Strasbourg will take a free kick near the side line.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Clement Turpin blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the free kick, but it's a bit too strong and the ball goes behind for a goal kick.
45+3' The resulting set piece from Monaco is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+3' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
45+1' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) will deliver the corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Clement Turpin shows the yellow card to Wilfried Singo (Monaco) for a heavy challenge.
43' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Alaa Bellaarouch makes a comfortable save.
42' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
41' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
40' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco).
38' Clement Turpin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) and blew his whistle.

37' What a chance that is! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.

35' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.

34' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
32' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
29' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
25' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
24' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
23' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) pounces on the cross and fires in a shot on goal from close range, but Radoslaw Majecki is alert and makes a decent save.
22' The corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is intercepted by the defence.
22' A cross into the box from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is cleared. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
21' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Clement Turpin saw the whole situation.
20' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
19' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
19' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg win a corner kick.
18' Strasbourg hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
15' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' A pass by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
12' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
8' The game is interrupted now, Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
6' One of the players from Strasbourg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes a direct free kick.
5' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
5' Today's referee Clement Turpin rightly decides to book Takumi Minamino (Monaco) for his harsh tackle.
4' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
3' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
1' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Strasbourg will take the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will referee today's match.
